program.name: Court-Based Rental Assistance Program (CBRAP)
program.description_short: One-time grant for Illinois renters facing an eviction case filed for unpaid rent
program.description:
CBRAP helps Illinois renters facing eviction in court for unpaid rent. If you are behind on rent but no one has filed an eviction case, this program cannot help you yet. The rented home must be your primary residence.

CBRAP pays up to $10,000 in total. The money can go toward the rent you already owe, some future rent, and eligible court costs. It is a grant, so you do not pay it back. This benefit is one time only. A household approved in the past 18 months cannot get it again.

Your landlord can also submit their part of the application. If they do, the two applications will be matched. If your landlord does not take part, you may still get help. The money may be paid to you directly.

Click 'Apply Online' to complete the CBRAP application.

navigators.name: Eviction Help Illinois
navigators.description: Eviction Help Illinois offers free legal help, mediation, and housing referrals. They can help you find other support while CBRAP is closed.

navigators.name: Neighborhood Housing Services of Chicago
navigators.description: NHS Chicago helps renters dealing with eviction, money problems, and landlord issues. They can help you find other housing support while CBRAP is closed.
